camera.coordinate_frame: camera optical center; +X right, +Y down, +Z forward

measurement_method: Measure from the stereo camera optical-center plane to each FUEL sphere center. Record the tape-measure uncertainty. Predicted Euclidean range is sqrt(X^2+Y^2+Z^2); predicted forward depth is Z.
scene_notes: Record lighting, ball arrangement, occlusion, and whether the camera or targets move.
